kūṭeti.p: [Kūṭa+ṇe+ti] (kri) CL=8 It is devious and cruel (or) it is cunning. Kūṭayati -  Look.
a: ကောက်ကျစ်စဉ်းလဲ၏။ ကူဋယတိ-ကြည့်။

B:

K:
kūṭeti：ကူဋေတိ （ကြိ）
[ကူဋ+ဏေ+တိ]
ကောက်ကျစ်စဉ်းလဲ၏။ ကူဋယတိ-ကြည့်။
DOP: kūṭeti, ~ayati pr. 3 sg. [ S. Dhātup. kūṭayate, Wg § 33:28 ], is confused or foul; is not clear or calm (or genuine ? ) ; Sadd 532, 16 (kūṭa appasāde: ~eti ~ayati, kūṭaṃ rajataṃ kūṭā gāvī kūṭatapaso).

kūṭeyya.p: [Kūṭa+ṇeyya] (na) CL=8 as the state of cunning (devious and cruel), the cunning case. Kūṭeyya kūṭeyya(kri) [kūṭa+ṇe+eyya]  they are devious and cruel. Kūṭayati - See.
a: ကောက်ကျစ်စဉ်းလဲသည်၏အဖြစ်၊ ကောက်ကျစ်စဉ်းလဲ-ခြင်း-မှု။ kūṭeyya ကူဋေယျ(ကြိ) [ကူဋ+ဏေ+ဧယျ]  ကောက်ကျစ်စဉ်းလဲရာ၏။ ကူဋယတိ-ကြည့်။

DOP: kūṭeyya n. [ from kūṭa 2 ], trickery; trick; trickiness ; M I 340, 28 ([hatthidammo] sabbāni tāni sāṭheyyāni ~āni vaṅkeyyāni jimheyyāni pātukarissati; Ps III 7, 16 : ~ānī ti kūṭattāni); A IV 189, 2 ([assājāniyo] yāni … assa honti sāṭheyyāni ~āni … tāni yathābhūtaṃ sārathissa āvikattā hoti); V 167, 2 ([assa khaluṅkassa] sāṭheyyāni ~āni … appahīnāni); — kūṭeyya(ṃ) in eds at Peṭ 204, 5 is prob. wr; see Ñāṇamoli, 1964, p. 276.
